title: Black vs Coloured Tattoo Removal
h1: Black and coloured tattoo removal: how many sessions you need
desc: Black ink vs coloured tattoo removal: why colours behave differently, typical number of sessions, intervals and what affects results, at Skin & Laser Dubai Marina.
answer: Black and dark blue ink absorb laser energy best and usually fade fastest. Colours such as green, light blue and yellow need specific wavelengths and often more sessions. Most tattoos need 6 to 12 sessions spaced 6 to 8 weeks apart, depending on ink, density, age and location.
body:
## What affects the number of sessions

- Ink colour and density
- Professional or amateur tattoo
- Age of the tattoo
- Location: closer to the heart clears faster
- Your health and whether you smoke

## Our technology

We use [Q-switch laser](/blog/q-switch-laser-dubai/) and [pico laser](/treatments/pico-laser-dubai/) for tattoo removal, choosing the setting for each ink.
faq: Many can, but some colours may leave a faint shadow.
Why do sessions need 6 to 8 weeks between them?
The body keeps clearing ink between visits.
